content: This paper presents a new method for analyzing longitudinal data with categorical outcomes by simultaneously selecting important features and classifying them. The approach uses functional principal components and an adaptive optimization algorithm to efficiently handle high-dimensional data and is tested on simulations and a real-world application examining the relationship between chronic diseases and various health factors.
